purpose: Perform deterministic first-pass name/alias screening against the current OFAC SDN list and return whether one or more review candidates meet a caller-selected similarity threshold.

decisions.candidate_found: At least one current SDN primary name or alias scores at or above minScore.
decisions.no_candidate: No current SDN primary name or alias scores at or above minScore.
decisions.human_review: Required OFAC evidence is unavailable or cannot support a completed screening result.

claim_boundaries: candidate_found is a review signal, not a legal sanctions determination
the product does not perform OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis
identity resolution requires human review of identifiers and context
